items.title: DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning
items.summary_en: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks

items.title: QwenLM/FlashQLA: FlashQLA v0.1.4
items.summary_en:
# FlashQLA v0.1.4

## 🚀 Highlights

- **FP32 / TF32x3 cross-partition correction** by @Erix025 — the inter-card `h0` / `dht` fold now reads the gathered `(h, M)` buffers through slot maps (no unpack/reindex materialised), and picks FP32 or 3-pass TF32 correction at runtime from a wave-aware heur
items.summary_zh:
# FlashQLA v0.1.4

## 🚀 Highlights

- **FP32 / TF32x3 cross-partition correction** by @Erix025 — the inter-card `h0` / `dht` fold now reads the gathered `(h, M)` buffers through slot maps (no unpack/reindex materialised), and picks FP32 or 3-pass TF32 correction at runtime from a wave-aware heur
